en.title: Bubble Explosion
en.description:
On the board, bubbles of the same color that are adjacent up, down, left, or right form connected groups. A bubble is eligible to explode if it has at least two neighbors of the same color; all eligible bubbles and their same-colored neighbors explode simultaneously. Then the remaining bubbles in each column fall down, and empty cells are represented by 0. The process ends after a single explosion.

The input format and the supplementary limits listed for this problem were compiled by CSWork; they do not imply that the original source uses this protocol.
en.input: The first line contains rows cols; each of the next rows lines contains cols color integers. Source constraints: 1≤rows,cols≤100, 1≤color≤10⁴.
en.output: Output the rows×cols matrix after the explosion and the fall, with each row space-separated.
en.explanation: Process the input according to the rules in the statement; see the accompanying notes for the approach, proof, and complexity.
hints: Find same-color 4-directionally connected groups on the original board: a group of size at least 3 is marked to explode as a whole. All marks are decided simultaneously from the original board; then stably compact the remaining bubbles of each column to the bottom.
